name: shikanime-labs/skills
description: A curated catalog of self-improved agent skills for Hermes and compatible agents: two parallel org workflows (shikanime sk-*, cloud-pi-native cpn-*) covering the full discussion, issue, and PR lifecycle, with proven-done gates, assumption validation, jj-workspace parallel fan-out, and stacked PR landing.

skills.name: sk-dev-workflow
skills.description: Branch and push discipline for shikanime repos: push to origin (the org repo), jj bookmark tracking, assumption validation, issue-first lifecycle, and landing via gh stack or direct push.

skills.name: sk-async
skills.description: Split work into parallel isolated jj workspaces (depth-tree fan-out), join with multi-parent commits, and land as independent PRs or gh stack chains.

skills.name: sk-commit
skills.description: Commit in shikanime-labs and shikanime-studio repos: plain English imperative titles, Automata co-author trailer, repo-enforced hooks (gitlint, DCO) win.

skills.name: sk-discussion
skills.description: Open RFC Discussions in shikanime orgs as the pre-issue stage: converge on the problem, then derive the issue.

skills.name: sk-issue
skills.description: Open issues in shikanime-labs and shikanime-studio: body is the problem statement, acceptance criteria as command-decidable tasklist (the gate ledger), findings as comments.

skills.name: sk-issue-refine
skills.description: Iterate a problem to convergence inside its GitHub issue via research + comments: classify open questions (fog), resolve AFK research via delegate_task fan-out, post findings and candidate solutions as comments, then converge the body into a clean problem statement + decidable gate ledger.

skills.name: sk-issue-triage
skills.description: Triage an existing shikanime org issue: labels, assignee, milestone, project; close with rationale if not workable.

skills.name: sk-pr-triage
skills.description: Triage an existing shikanime org PR: labels, assignee, milestone, reviewers, issue linkage.

skills.name: sk-issue-workflow
skills.description: Single entry point for the shikanime issue side: create the issue, refine the problem to convergence within it, then triage immediately.

skills.name: sk-pr-workflow
skills.description: Single entry point for the shikanime PR side: ensure the issue exists, open the org-repo PR derived from the commit, then triage immediately.

skills.name: sk-discussion-triage
skills.description: Triage an existing shikanime org discussion: category, body shape, Q&A answer marking, lifecycle close (GraphQL).

skills.name: sk-pr
skills.description: Open PRs in shikanime orgs: push to origin, PR derived from the commit message, many-to-many issue linkage via Related, no auto-close keywords.

skills.name: sk-land
skills.description: Merge a shikanime org PR only after the linked issue's definition-of-done tasklist is discharged and sk-code-review approval is in place; squash+rebase or gh stack merge, then close the issue deliberately.

skills.name: sk-pr-resolve
skills.description: Reconcile a shikanime org PR's review conversations, check the DoD ledger, and report approval/CI state without merging — pre-landing resolution extracted from sk-land.

skills.name: sk-code-review
skills.description: Code review discipline for shikanime repos: YAGNI, root-cause, repo conventions, security scan, severity-tagged findings.

skills.name: sk-doc
skills.description: Document a shikanime project in the repo's docs/ directory: seed internal-ops and optional user-facing zones, edited as reviewable in-repo Markdown (Longhorn internal-ops / Kubernetes contributor docs / PyTorch PR-review patterns).

skills.name: cpn-dev-workflow
skills.description: Work inside the local cloud-pi-native console repo: contribution rules, dev cycle, gates, and PR workflow.

skills.name: cpn-commit
skills.description: Commit to cloud-pi-native/console with conventional format.

skills.name: cpn-discussion
skills.description: Create/edit console Discussions (French, GraphQL).

skills.name: cpn-issue
skills.description: Open CPN console issues with French templates and the definition-of-done gate ledger.

skills.name: cpn-pr
skills.description: Open cloud-pi-native org PRs with French body and conventional title.

skills.name: cpn-code-review
skills.description: Review cloud-pi-native console PRs: four-phase process, architecture checkpoints, French artifacts.

skills.name: cpn-issue-triage
skills.description: Triage une issue existante du dépôt cloud-pi-native/console : labels, assignee, jalon, projet ; fermeture motivée si non traitable.

skills.name: cpn-pr-triage
skills.description: Triage une PR existante du dépôt cloud-pi-native/console : labels, assignee, jalon, reviewers, lien issue.

skills.name: cpn-discussion-triage
skills.description: Triage une discussion existante du dépôt cloud-pi-native/console : catégorie, forme du corps, réponse Q&A, clôture de cycle (GraphQL).

skills.name: cpn-async
skills.description: Fan-out parallèle sur workspaces jj + PR en stack pour console cloud-pi-native.

skills.name: cpn-issue-refine
skills.description: Itère un problème vers la convergence dans son issue via recherche + commentaires (console).

skills.name: cpn-issue-workflow
skills.description: Point d'entrée unique côté issue cloud-pi-native : créer, raffiner, trier immédiatement.

skills.name: cpn-pr-workflow
skills.description: Point d'entrée unique côté PR cloud-pi-native : issue liée, PR draft dérivée, trier immédiatement.

skills.name: cpn-pr-resolve
skills.description: Réconcilie les threads de review d'une PR, vérifie le ledger DoD, rapporte sans merger.
